features.name: Illusion Savant
features.desc: You copy Illusion spells in half the time and for half the gold.

features.name: Improved Minor Illusion
features.desc: You know Minor Illusion and can create both a sound and an image with it at the same time.

features.name: Malleable Illusions
features.desc: As an action, you change the nature of your active illusions (with a duration of 1 minute or longer).

features.name: Illusory Self
features.desc: As a Reaction, you create a duplicate of yourself, causing an attack against you to miss.

features.name: Illusory Reality
features.desc: You make one nonliving object from an illusion real for 1 minute.
